_how_to_use: Copy this file, rename it, and edit the values for your site. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored. Run `python generic_scraper.py --config sites/yourfile.json --test` to see what gets extracted before a full run. Keep configs for private sites out of version control.
name: my_site
_age_gate: OPTIONAL. Only if the site shows a confirmation button first. A real browser clicks it once and its cookies are reused for fast HTTP fetching. Needs: pip install selenium
_use_browser: OPTIONAL. Set true if pages are rendered by JavaScript and plain HTML has no data.
_pagination: mode 'pattern': pages follow a URL pattern. {base} and {page} are filled in. The page count comes from ONE of: total_pages (number), total_pages_from (a rule), or total_items_from (a rule) + items_per_page. If none is given, pages are fetched until one has no items. mode 'next_link': needs first_url and next_selector (a link to the next page).
_listing: One 'card' per item on a listing page. 'link' is the URL of the item's detail page (also the unique key). Every entry in 'fields' becomes a column.

listing._ignore: OPTIONAL rules to skip cards that are not real items (ads). equals/contains compare a field (default: title) case-insensitively; 'external' skips links to other websites.

_detail: Rules for each item's own page. root_selector = the element holding the content (if it is missing the page counts as failed). 'fields' = single values; 'pairs' = label/value rows. Add "scope": "page" to a field or pair to search the whole page instead of only the root element.
_downloads: OPTIONAL. Files to download for each item, taken from a listing field. Enable with --download thumbnails (or --download all).
